newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to move Henry Hub natgas expiration forward.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to move Henry Hub natgas expiration forward.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Tuesday it will move the expiration of its Henry Hub natural gas futures forward to the third to last business day of the month, effective with the June contract.
Currently, the Henry Hub futures contract expires on the fifth to last business day of the month.
NYMEX said the expiration of corresponding options will be on the business day immediately prior to the futures expiry.
